title: File:Indian Mehndi Culture (1) 05.jpg
desc:
In Indian culture, mehndi is considered auspicious and a symbol of prosperity. It is also considered a sign of good luck.
It have applied on Bride & Groom before Wedding in Both the Hands.

Some of the place is seems that darker the color of the mehndi means more love between them.
